source_brief.scene: A monumental friendly original teal-and-amber dragon LED skeleton on a dry dark stage, small crisp head, helix torso and two broad symmetric open-rib wings. Three physically separate overlapping wing-outline pose layers on supported frames. Hero shows fully lifted wings. Bottom four storyboard cells show wings raised, level, folded down, lifted again. Clear single dragon body, dim inactive wing outlines, no derivative franchise creature.
